scenario.summary: Guest searches a simple product, checks its name, SKU, sales price and retail price on the PLP card and in Quick View, sets quantity 2, adds it to the cart from Quick View and checks the cart row total and the 'YOUR TOTAL IS ... For 1 Item' heading (2 x sales price). The guest cart is emptied in afterEach.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState).
Search the SKU; check hdgProductName141, divProductSKUContainer141, spnSalesPrice141, spnRetailPrice141.
Open Quick View; check the name and the sales and retail prices inside divSalesPrice141.
Set quantity 2, Add to Cart from Quick View, go to the cart from the notification.
afterEach: Remove All Items from the cart.
stateChanges: Guest cart filled with the simple product (quantity 2); emptied by afterEach (Remove All Items)

Cart row total equals quantity x sales price ($108.00).
Total heading reads 'YOUR TOTAL IS $108.00 For 1 Item'.
evidence: Title 'verify sales and retail price for simple product' and the four step labels match the flow; guest storageState; no linked AIO cases.
